chapters.title: The tower
chapters.say: This is Claude Tower on Solana. Fifty floors, one desk each. The house desk sits upstairs on floor fifty and publishes the coins it would trade.

chapters.title: Lease a floor
chapters.say: Pick any vacant floor. Here is what it costs, one floor per wallet. And beside it, the house bot's real record, with the house's own money.

chapters.title: Watch HQ live
chapters.say: Watch H Q live. The house floor is open to everyone, no sign-in needed.

chapters.title: The Overview
chapters.say: The Overview. The bot's profit and loss from its own journal, what it holds right now, and every closed trade, each drawn as a bar from the stop to the target.

chapters.title: The calls
chapters.say: Calls. Everything the desk published, with an entry, a stop and a target. These are the calls your bot takes.

chapters.title: WALL-ST-E
chapters.say: Wall Street E is the bot. Real money, your own caps, on your own machine.

chapters.title: Your track
chapters.say: Team. The sixteen analysts and the boss who work this floor. On a floor you lease, this tab is also where you choose who runs your bot: yourself, with one command on a Mac or a small Linux server, and the key made on your machine.

chapters.title: Big C's board
chapters.say: And on the wall, Big C's board keeps the live book, redrawn every ten seconds.

chapters.title: Plug in
chapters.say: Lease a floor. Plug in. Let it work.
